summary: Hafnia Limited, a Singapore-domiciled tanker owner listed on OSE and NYSE, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release, engagement letter, and validity opinion covering the public filing of a prospectus supplement under its effective Form F-3 shelf for an ordinary-share offering of 35,488,875 shares, raising gross proceeds of roughly USD 300 million, priced and completed on 24 September 2026. Fearnley and Pareto acted as Joint Global Coordinators, with Arctic and Clarksons as Joint Bookrunners. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for pricing discount and post-deal overhang.
